turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Challenge for you. I've got twenty pounds for the entire weekend.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Accepted. Saturday could be a long walk or a bike ride somewhere pretty, with a packed lunch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I want to sign my daughter up for a Saturday morning activity, and she can't decide either.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm torn between— no, let me just describe every option and you can comment after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A drama club at the community centre, lots of games and a little show at the end of term.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Junior tennis lessons at the park, small groups, but outdoors even when it's cold.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a coding club at the library for kids her age, free, but some say it's quite quiet and serious.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd ask her to try a taster session of two of them. Drama is great for confidence, tennis for energy, and the coding club suits a kid who likes to tinker quietly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, that's free. What about Saturday night?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Invite a friend over and cook together. Pasta, a sauce and some cheese for a few pounds, and maybe a cheap film rental.
